chunks: There is no dying for us but once; and we shall not be raised again.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the finality of death and resurrection?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ad-Dukhan, this verse serves as a rhetorical rebuttal to the polytheists who, in their arrogance, claimed that death was an absolute end with no possibility of resurrection. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Allama al-Tabatabai in *Al-Mizan*, highlight that 'our first death' implies a singular earthly life, contrasting with the eternal life to come, thereby affirming the logical necessity of the Hereafter for divine justice.
